text:
sahil: Kicking off deploy for v3.12.0 -> eu-west1. Canary 10% for 15m. Post-deploy smoketests will run. Change window 21:00-22:00 UTC. pinging oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started (canary=10%) group=canary-eu-8892. Tracking: https://deploys/internal/1777777000

emma: can we run the edgeprobe synthetic across eu-west1 and eu-central in parallel? last time eu-central showed heartbeat drift.

lucas: +1. i'll kick off parallel synthetics. Also request: disable prefix-cache invalidation for the canary to avoid TTL churn (one-liner in rollout config).

ops-bot: ops-bot: synthetic-run syn-8892 (edge-probe v3.12.0) -> eu-west1 started. baseline p95=220ms.

emma: threshold: if p95 > 400ms OR error_rate > 1% -> hold and pin to v3.11.9. notify oncall. :warning:

sahil: acknowledged. rollback playbook ready. if smoke fails we'll pause and pin. i'll also annotate release notes with the tokenizer tweak to avoid confusion.

ops-bot: ops-bot: syn-8892 reporting: 21:05 spike detected — p95=460ms, errors=1.3%. marking canary UNHEALTHY and firing alert.

anya: oncall here, i've paused the rollout and started traffic drain back to stable. can someone pls grab gateway logs 21:05..21:10? e.g. `logs gateway-prod --region eu-west1 --from 2026-03-21T21:05Z --to 2026-03-21T21:10Z`

lucas: looking at logs — transient GC spikes on host gpu-32a at 21:05, multiple long pauses ~300-800ms. pushing a runtime softfix to adjust GC threshold, but i don't want to retry deploy yet. recommend pin.

sahil: agree — rolling back canary to v3.11.9 and pining eu-west1. opening rollback ticket and updating release notes now. @emma please hold on publishing changelog until we confirm stability.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout paused; canary rollback initiated -> pinned version=v3.11.9. ticket=#DL-5421.

emma: ack. once rollback finishes let's run an extended 30m synthetic across both regions before a new attempt. also add the failing probe id and sample logs to the release notes.

ops-bot: ops-bot: checklist reminder — capture synthetic script snippet, failing probe id syn-8892, and prefix-cache flag state for postmortem. :memo:

sahil: thanks all. I'll post a short rollback summary in the release channel and mark this change window as a partial rollback. We can reconvene after the 30m verification.
